method: B (launch story), very thin data. PPC Guru launched Search ~June 2026. Only two months exist; June is a partial launch-ramp month, so July 2026 is the first full month.
genuine_lead_definition: PHONE_CALL_LEAD + SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM. No local-action / outbound-click categories exist; raw metrics.conversions = genuine leads. Fractional conversion values rounded to whole leads.
headline_basis: First full month (Jul 2026) = 12 genuine leads (8 form quote requests + 4 calls) at ~$124 each. Very early launch; treat June as ramp only.
caveats: Only ~1 full month of meaningful data. Not enough for a trend claim. Re-pull after Q3 2026 completes.
